confidence_notes: Uyuni is small and has no reliable aggregated price index. Food and drink anchors come from one web search, which returned travel-blog and aggregator figures. Those showed beer about $1.50-2.90, coffee about $1.50-2.50, a basic restaurant meal about $3-6, and a mid-range meal about $10-20 per person. The midrange_meal_2p figure is a bounded estimate from those ranges. Cocktail and wine were not directly sourced. I set cocktail at about 2.5 times beer and wine at about 2 times beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from booking pages or listings. They are uncertain because prices vary by season and tourist demand. The FX figure is the RBA's 18 Nov 2026 observation, found through search. The search snippet gave 0.6720 USD per AUD; I did not open the RBA page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Uyuni-specific traveller price ranges found in search, cross-checked against other Bolivian tourist towns such as Sucre and Potosí. Uyuni runs slightly higher for tourist-oriented venues.
